The authority’s Railway Transport Statistics 2025 showed that intracity railway passengers increased by 368 percent to 145.4 million, up from 31.1 million in 2024. Meanwhile, intercity railway passengers declined by 5.6 percent to 10.9 million, compared with 11.6 million in the previous year.
